research_question: Can native completed H1/H4 EMA states observed before B02/F05 entry define a portable permission layer that improves portfolio P/L after measured winner damage?
distinction: HYP-023 was a primary native-H4 entry architecture. This study preserves every canonical B02/F05 entry and outcome and evaluates only a pre-entry permission overlay.

effect_contract.loser_benefit_jpy: sum positive blocked_trade_delta_jpy on baseline losers
effect_contract.winner_damage_jpy: absolute sum negative blocked_trade_delta_jpy on baseline winners

selection.held_out_portability_gate: held-out net delta > 0 in at least 3 of 4 folds
selection.breadth_gate: held-out B02 and F05 net delta are each non-negative in at least 3 of 4 folds
selection.support_gate: selected held-out rule blocks at least 5 trades in every fold

prohibited: no threshold or period expansion after outcomes
no side, session, year or strategy exception
no combination with Entry Establishment Phase 2 rules
no candidate or production authorization from descriptive pooled positivity
